origin: the built-in key pose has non-coplanar feet (spread 0.0166), four legs on a joint bound, and collapses to COM 0.18 with 29 percent of the weight on non-foot geometry when it bears load. A solved stand pose (COM 1.35, feet coplanar to 2.6e-5, non-foot clearance 0.515) holds load on feet alone with zero non-foot contact. This round redoes the whole reference pipeline starting from that pose.

changes.start_pose: the retarget's initial guess, continuity anchor and key-frame regularisation target all become STAND_POSE_2 (42 joint angles + root height 1.4723 from experiments/banc-stand-pose/20261108T170000Z)
nothing_else: solver settings (TRF, analytic Jacobian, max_nfev 80/16, step limit 0.06, weights)
frozen body XML (unchanged, the pose is a runtime parameter, not a model edit)

pipeline: retarget 232 snippets from the stand pose
train full 42-joint PPO with reward v4
evaluate with the frozen criteria in two modes (grip off = frozen body, grip on = derived channel) and two windows (full release, steady)

acceptance.to_continue: each stage must complete without error and the numbers must be recorded whether good or bad
acceptance.to_pass: no gate is relaxed; the question is only whether the new start pose changes slip, height and non-foot contact

labelling: replacement ANN only; grip-on results are derived-channel; the frozen-body status stays unaccepted unless the frozen gates are met with grip off
